title: UNIT replication package: Representation Learning for Semiparametric Causal Mediation Analysis under No Essential Heterogeneity
description: Reproduction code and frozen simulation data for the two-stage G-estimation study (UNIT) of structural mediation parameters under No Essential Heterogeneity, in which the Stage-1 mediator-CATE learner is varied across a four-rung ladder (Ridge, tuned Random Forest, neural T-learner, and TARNet) to isolate how Stage-1 learning drives Stage-2 efficiency. The package is frozen at 200 Monte-Carlo seeds per cell; scripts/verify.py confirms byte-for-byte reproduction of every table and figure. Released under the MIT License; vendors CATENets (BSD-3-Clause).
